oxblood.$description: Oxblood — The singular chromatic identity — display headlines, nav links, body text, borders, and the active theme toggle. This muted dark-wine red carries all brand presence; the system is monochrome with this one warm, desaturated red as the only color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas and card surfaces. The background that the typography sits on; it reads as gallery white, not pure technical white

carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Secondary text, decorative borders, and structural hairlines. Used as the neutral companion to Oxblood when chromatic emphasis isn't needed

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text and body borders. A softer near-black for inline content where pure black feels too harsh

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, the inactive theme toggle label, and low-emphasis annotations

crimson.$description: Crimson — Red outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

neue-haas-display.$description: The display face used for the nameplate and role titles. Sits at 135–188px with tight negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.020em) — the oversized scale is the signature; there is no intermediate heading tier, just utility text and then this monumental display.

sfuidisplay.$description: Body and utility type. Weight 300 whispers at body sizes for a quiet, label-like reading voice; weight 400 carries the uppercase tracked annotations (8–12px) that label sections and form microcopy. The narrow range (8–21px) confirms this is a system with two voices: monumental display or quiet label.

arial.$description: Rare fallback for button labels where the custom faces aren't available — not a designed choice, a system safety net.
